# ContactPage: its buttons, fields and dropdowns

What the crawl saw on this page that a visitor can use (links are in
ai/GLOSSARY.md), read only: nothing was clicked, typed or sent. Each locator matched exactly one element
on the page it was read from. Those it trusts are already in `ContactElements`, each with the method
that uses it; a fragile one (its locator counts positions) is not, and has a line to paste into the
**elements** YOURS block once checked against a saved page (ai/recipes/add-an-element.md). Controls on most pages (a footer form) are in

## "Let's Build Something" form (in the page)

- **"Name*" / "Your name"**: text field. In `ContactElements` as `NAME_INPUT`: `enter().name(...)`.
- **"Email*" / "you@company.com"**: email field. In `ContactElements` as `EMAIL_INPUT`: `enter().email(...)`.
- **"Mobile" / "+1 (555) 000-0000"**: tel field. In `ContactElements` as `MOBILE_INPUT`: `enter().mobile(...)`.
- **"Company" / "Optional"**: text field. In `ContactElements` as `COMPANY_INPUT`: `enter().company(...)`.
- **"Project Type*"**: dropdown. In `ContactElements` as `PROJECT_TYPE_SELECT`: `enter().projectType(option)`.
- **"Message*" / "Tell us what you're building…"**: text area. In `ContactElements` as `MESSAGE_INPUT`: `enter().message(...)`.
- **"Send Message"**: button. In `ContactElements` as `SEND_MESSAGE_BUTTON`: `click().sendMessage()`.
